text.tspan: FRAME — Two dated cards from the two lanes of page 109, placed
touching but not joined. Left, hatched: 26 JUNE — RESEARCHERS
ATTRIBUTE CONCENTRATED VISITS TO THE WIKI TO
ARCHIVED PAGES. Right, solid: 27 JUNE — RESPONDERS IDENTIFY
THE EVALUATION, THE BOARD, AND THE PIVOT, AND ADVISE THAT
ACTION — One day apart, two channels, and no record of whether
knowledge of one reached the people handling the other.
CAPTION — “DID THE PEOPLE WHO FOUND ONE CHANNEL TALK TO
THE PEOPLE WHO DECIDED ABOUT THE OTHER? THE RECORD
DOES NOT SAY. THE BOOK WILL NOT GUESS.”

g.text: MISSING FROM THE ACCOUNT · PANEL 3 · PLACEHOLDER
